description: ADR-006 newsletter pipeline: brief → research(fan-out) → copy → audit(loop) → publish

research_lulu.directive: Research the top 3 AI agent stories this week from Lulu's angle. Produce research_lulu.json with sources, summaries, and angles.

research_thoth.directive: Research the top 3 AI agent stories this week from Thoth's angle. Produce research_thoth.json with sources, summaries, and angles.

copy.directive: Write the newsletter copy based on the merged research. Produce copy_output.md.

audit.directive: Audit the newsletter copy in copy_output.md. Check facts, tone, and formatting. Produce audit_report.json with result: pass/fail and notes.

publish.directive: Build and deliver the final newsletter. Produce final_newsletter.md and send to Jesse.
